turns.text: Hey Lloyd, the CI pipeline is green again. I finally fixed that flaky test in the auth module.
Great news, Alan. Glad to hear the flakiness is resolved. Do you need help reviewing the fix?
No, just wanted to log it. Oh, also, did you see those new nodes in the knowledge graph? They're cluttering everything.
Which nodes specifically? I can check the metadata.
The ones generated during the nightly run. They're useless. They were created by nightly reflection, causing graph pollution with 349+ neighbors on a generic session hub.
I see. That sounds like an issue with the aggregation logic. I'll flag it for review.
Yeah, please do. Also, can you remind me to order the new ergonomic mouse? My wrist is killing me.
Added to your reminders. Shall I search for specific models?
Not yet, I'll pick one later. Thanks.
